# The API reference covers PeachDrawing.Core, PeachDrawing and PeachDrawing.Text

**What:** `docs/api/` (generated by DefaultDocumentation, git-ignored) used to hold only PeachPDF. `src/ApiReference.props` now gives
`PeachDrawing.Core`, `PeachDrawing` and `PeachDrawing.Text` the same generation, each into `docs/api/<package>/`; `pages.yml` builds all four
and runs `Fix-ApiDocLinks.ps1` over each folder. `PeachDrawing.Text.Data` has no public API, so it has no reference.

**Traps found by running it:**
- DefaultDocumentation's `Name` file-name factory does not qualify a page by assembly, so the packages cannot share a folder; PeachPDF
  stays at the root of `docs/api/` so existing links to its pages keep working.
- The shared props file is imported before a project's own properties, so the folder uses `$(MSBuildProjectName)`, not `$(AssemblyName)`
  (which is empty at that point and would write every package into `docs/api/`).
- `Fix-ApiDocLinks.ps1` reads only one directory's top level, so it runs once per package folder.
- "API Reference" in `nav.yml` is now a dropdown. A child with `prefix` owns the pages under it and the one marked `fallback` owns the rest
  of `/api/` (PeachPDF's), so `/api/PeachDrawing.Core/...` lights up Core, not PeachPDF. Checked by building a scratch copy of the site with
  Jekyll and reading the active links for each path.

**Evidence:** all three generate cleanly (657, 533 and 138 pages), and the packed nupkgs' dependencies are unchanged (PrivateAssets keeps
DefaultDocumentation out of them).
